caption: The drawing depicts a wooden chair with a woven straw seat. The chair has four legs, all of which are dark-colored, possibly black or dark brown, and are turned with rounded shapes. The chair has armrests that are also dark and curved. The backrest comprises three vertical spindles and a horizontal top rail that is shaped with slight curves and ends in round finials. The woven straw seat is light brown and arranged in a chevron or diamond pattern. The chair's legs are connected by horizontal stretchers, some of which are also turned and dark in color. The background is plain and uncolored, leaving the chair as the sole object in the image. The drawing is bordered by a thin, straight frame, and there is a signature in the bottom right corner.
title: High Chair
